title: Enforcing Regulation when Violations are Heterogeneous: Empirical Evidence from U.S. Stationary Emissions Policy
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Enforcement of environmental regulation in the United States is often delegated from the federal level to local authorities. This devolution of responsibility poses a significant challenge when local regulators differ in their knowledge and priorities regarding the harm posed by environmental violations. Using plant-level data from the Environmental Protection Agency, we exploit variation in the application of a 2014 revision to the criteria for classifying severe violations under the Clean Air Act. We find that following the revision, plants located in states most impacted by the policy exhibited a greater decrease in emissions. As a result, the overall emissions-related damages from stationary sources of air pollution decreased by 2.5%, equivalent to $2.4 billion annually. These results provide quasi-experimental evidence on the effectiveness of limiting regulatory discretion and the importance of marginal deterrence in enforcement.
abstract_zh: 在美国，环境监管的执行通常由联邦层面下放至地方机构。当地方监管机构对环境违法行为所造成的危害的认识和优先事项存在差异时，这种责任下放就带来了重大挑战。利用美国环境保护署（EPA）的工厂层面数据，我们利用了2014年对《清洁空气法》中严重违规认定标准修订的执行差异。我们发现，修订之后，受政策影响最大的州的工厂，其排放量下降幅度更大。因此，固定污染源空气污染造成的总体排放相关损害每年减少了2.5%，相当于每年24亿美元。这些结果为限制监管自由裁量权的有效性，以及执法中边际威慑的重要性，提供了准实验证据。

title: Effects of Mergers and Acquisitions on US Agri-Food Trade
Midstream Infrastructure and Environmental Externalities in Oil and Gas: Permian Basin Flaring and Methane Emissions
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We estimate the short-run causal effect of congestion in natural gas transmission infrastructure on upstream environmental externalities from oil and gas production in the Permian basin between 2015 and 2021. We estimate that congestion caused 34 percent of flaring and 10 percent of methane emissions, valued at $524M and $674M in annual climate costs. At the well level, we find that gas wells reduce output in response to congestion, while oil wells, which produce the majority of Permian gas, do not. Instead, oil wells flare excess gas. We also find evidence that wells vertically integrated with a processing plant also respond differently compared to wells that are not, suggesting market structure matters. Our results have implications for the design of methane and flaring regulations and demonstrate how, when resources are jointly produced, transportation constraints on one resource may lead to increased pollution, not reduced production.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了2015至2021年间，二叠纪盆地天然气输送基础设施拥堵对石油和天然气上游生产环境外部性的短期因果效应。我们估计，拥堵导致了34%的火炬燃烧和10%的甲烷排放，分别相当于每年5.24亿美元和6.74亿美元的气候成本。在井层面，我们发现，天然气井会因拥堵而减少产量，而石油井（其生产了二叠纪盆地的大部分天然气）则不会。相反，石油井会燃烧多余的天然气。我们还发现，与未进行纵向一体化的井相比，与加工厂纵向一体化的井的反应也有所不同，这表明市场结构很重要。我们的结果对甲烷和火炬燃烧监管的设计具有启示意义，并表明，当资源是联合生产时，对一种资源的运输约束可能导致污染增加，而非产量减少。

title: Escalation of Scrutiny: The Gains from Dynamic Enforcement of Environmental Regulations
abstract: The US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) uses a dynamic approach to enforcing air pollution regulations, with repeat offenders subject to high fines and designation as high priority violators (HPV). We estimate the value of dynamic enforcement by developing and estimating a dynamic model of a plant and regulator, where plants decide when to invest in pollution abatement technologies. We use a fixed grid approach to estimate random coefficient specifications. Investment, fines, and HPV designation are costly to most plants. Eliminating dynamic enforcement would raise pollution damages by 164 percent with constant fines or raise fines by 519 percent with constant pollution damages. (JEL Q52, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 美国环境保护署（EPA）对空气污染监管采取动态执法方式，对屡次违规者处以高额罚款，并将其认定为高优先级违规者（High Priority Violator, HPV）。我们通过构建并估计一个由工厂与监管者组成的动态模型，来评估动态执法的价值，其中工厂需决定何时投资污染治理技术。我们采用固定网格方法来估计随机系数设定。投资、罚款以及HPV认定对大多数工厂而言都是有成本的。若取消动态执法，在罚款额不变的情况下，污染损害将上升164%；在污染损害不变的情况下，罚款将上升519%。（JEL Q52, Q53, Q58）
